Chapter 6353: Limit Break

Chapter 6353: Limit Break

Ten-realm, albeit not the youngest, was the most talented emperor in Desolate Frontier. He reached the apex stage in the shortest time.

This earned him the respect of numerous cultivators. They viewed him as a role model, hoping to one day become like him. They believed it wouldn’t take long for him to obtain a primal anima, only a matter of time. After all, he was selected to become Eleventh-gen Chen.

Thus, Driedtree Emperor performing the process before him surprised them. Once upon a time, this was expected since she was a long-time follower of Desolate Ancestor as a maid.

However, once Desolate Ancestor left, she no longer had any affiliation with Desolate Frontier since her master allowed her to return to her original sect.

Although she brought this sect to Desolate Frontier, she was not under anyone’s control. After all, none dared to give commands to their progenitor’s closest confidante.

Because of this, her status in Desolate Frontier was rather strange. On the surface, she and her sect were under Desolate Frontier’s control but in reality, she had complete autonomy.

Seeing her obtaining a primal anima in the sect surprised some and annoyed a few more. Ten-realm was one of them because breaking the limit became more distant given current events.

“We must take everything back.” He clenched his fists while observing the divine rings.

This glory should have been his first - the man with the potential to become a supreme overlord. Now, an outsider was going to surpass him using his resources. He felt as if she was riding on his head.

“Break!” Driedtree’s true fate intensified and released its dao laws to destroy the divine rings.

However, the divine rings came from her supreme grand dao and coiled around it in a frenzy.

“Clank!” They didn’t hold back, seemingly wanting to destroy the grand dao.

Her tree then poured down anima power into the grand dao. It took roots into the ground and channeled worldly energy into it.

“Boom!” The grand dao became far stronger. Laws intertwined and turned into a world pillar, only an inch away from reaching the heaven itself.

Unfortunately, due to the innate connection between the grand dao and the divine rings, the latter also grew stronger.

They retaliated by coming together to form a single divine ring, gaining the power of a binding curse. This thick entity wrapped around the pillar, not allowing the process to continue.

“Go!” Driedtree prepared for this. Laws evolved in her eyes and turned into a dao chapter.

Idle Peak beneath her sent out another dao chapter, forming a full version when combined with her own. It turned into a maelstrom to harness the life force of the peak, sending it straight to her supreme grand dao.

“Rumble!” The whole sect shook violently due to the explosion of life force from Idle Peak.

“It’s incredible.” Jaws dropped to the ground.

Just one strand of this life force was immensely beneficial to regular cultivators. As for her, she was using an oceanic amount to empower her supreme grand dao.

“Just one leaf from that tree is akin to a world.” An emperor became envious, thinking that possessing this peak guaranteed the primal realm.

“Boom!” The grand dao gained a second wind, surging from the chaos like a golden dragon. It birthed more dao laws, forming several more pillars to stop the single divine ring.
